backparadise.host: Byron “B-Note” Brown and Derrick “D Train” Coleman
backparadise.desc: WPFW's first soulful deep house program, carrying the spirit of the Paradise Garage into the present.

blackstarradio.desc: A late-night journey through the music and voices of Africa, the Caribbean, and the global Black diaspora.

brotherahrsquocollectnextgeneratins.host: Herb Taylor, Craig Hall, and Black Ink
brotherahrsquocollectnextgeneratins.desc: Jazz curated for spiritually higher values, carrying forward the legacy of the late Robert “Brother Ah” Northern.

comcomb.desc: In-depth interviews with the advocates, organizers, and historians who have shaped American life.
comcomb.tags: Civil rights, housing segregation, movement history

deciphersat.host: The Decipher Hip Hop Collective, including Eddie Smith, Ron Brown, and DJ Machete
deciphersat.desc: Golden Era hip hop and the original samples behind it, from the collective that fought to put the genre on WPFW.

dontforotgross.desc: Don’t Forget the Blues with Ida Campbell approaches the blues as history that is still being made.

dontforgebluesthurs.desc: Don’t Forget the Blues with Warren “Scooter” Magruder uses storytelling to guide listeners through the history of vintage R&B and the blues.

gstringomecole.desc: The guitar and its relatives, tracing the connections between peoples and cultures. On air since 1977.

soulhouse.desc: A completely freestyle house and soul set. No formula, no script.

ovjazzda.desc: Rare jazz and soul on vinyl, from the owner of a D.C. record shop and music festival producer.

jamsesslifemusi.desc: A 360-degree exposure to the world's most potent musical traditions, and never the same show twice.

pmjazzd.desc: Forty-plus years of jazz broadcasting, from the WDCU studios to WPFW.

konbitlsdayiti.desc: The only Haitian broadcast program serving the DMV, in English and Haitian Creole.

kulcha.host: DJ Zee-Lion and Sista Kim Bey
kulcha.desc: Reggae and diaspora sounds from an award-winning musician who lived the culture before he broadcast it.

latinflimbyers.desc: Palladium Ballroom-era Latin jazz, 1946 to 1966, and one of very few programs in the country doing this work.

opensky.desc: Two hours on Sunday afternoons: the first for the classic side of the music, the second for what's new.
opensky.tags: Jazz, classic and contemporary, new releases

dcpolitebarras.desc: The art and soul of the American labor movement: songs, stories, and struggles of the working class.
dcpolitebarras.tags: Labor, labor history, arts and culture
